description: Which issues and wiki pages refer to a legal act — the list on the act's card. Per document the value names (the same act in two languages is two): 'total' issue-and-place and page-and-place lines, 'hidden' of them where you may not read (counted, never named), and 'items' — the 'place' cited with the 'issue' (key, summary) or the 'page' (id, title, spaceKey). Only accepted references in projects that keep them count; a comment's reference is its issue's. Name the act by its key (e.g. 32015L0849), its address, the document id, or words of its title. The same set of issues is JQL's legalRef = "…".

document.description: The act: its key (e.g. '32015L0849'), its address, a document id, or words of its title.

limit.description: How many lines, at most 200. Default 50.

project.description: Only this project's, by its key. Omit for every project you read.

startAt.description: Where to start, for a list longer than one answer.

name: find_by_legal_document
title: Find by legal document
